name: The Eraser's Finger
summary: Finger of Death once per long rest. The price: Intelligence -4, and each casting takes a memory you loved.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_vault (the hall of vestiges).

benefit.text: Once a day you can point at a living thing and unmake it, from the inside out.

cost.flaw: Every time you use it, a memory you loved goes with the dead. You won't know which until you reach for it.
cost.text: The vestige eats what you know. It starts at once, and it never quite finishes.
